lessons: A <button> nested inside the row's <button class=r-main> was silently splitting the row DOM; use <span role=button>.
background-clip:text on a parent with animated inline-block children hides the text; clip on the children.
Line-clamp/ellipsis on mixed RTL/LTR lines mis-cuts; clip by max-height instead.
The repo's scripts cannot run from a cloud chat without attaching the repo; the classifier refuses external code.
Two sessions publishing to one artifact: the publish tool refuses a version not built on the live one and saves the live source; compare both renders before choosing a base, and say so in the report.
Zebra striping must use :nth-child(even of .row) when sticky group headers share the list; plain nth-child(even) flips parity after every header.
A sticky bar with backdrop-filter makes position:fixed children resolve against the bar; drop the blur before using a fixed bottom sheet inside it.
A fragment forced to direction:ltr inside an RTL line puts a leading separator on its left; keep fragments in the paragraph direction (isolate only) or the dots land between the wrong items.
The owner's own words decide the default: cards were a good idea for search results but they wanted the table; keep such ideas behind a switch instead of as the default.

Camera inside a claude.ai artifact: no capability to declare; getUserMedia may be blocked by the iframe policy, so the overlay degrades to a capture=environment file input, which always opens the phone camera.

The claude.ai artifact frame host is unreachable from the container, so the iframe camera permission policy cannot be probed here; design the camera for both outcomes and tell the owner which one they hit.
A sticky element clicked by Playwright scrolls the page to it; drive such clicks with element.click() when the test depends on scroll position.
border-inline-* on an <input dir=auto> follows the input's own direction (LTR when empty), not the page's; grid dividers on inputs must use physical sides.
